# std::shared_ptr<TerrainGenerator>

> **Kind:** context · **Registry:** both · **Folder:** [`src/logic/terrain/`](../folders/src-logic-terrain.md)
> **Source:** [`src/logic/terrain/terrain_generator.h`](../../../src/logic/terrain/terrain_generator.h), [`src/logic/terrain/terrain_generator.cpp`](../../../src/logic/terrain/terrain_generator.cpp)

## Summary

Shared density function of the marching cubes world (FastNoise2 heightfield plus 3D overhang noise).

## Description

Context variable holding a shared TerrainGenerator, safe to call from several threads. Host: emplaced by ChunkGeneratorSys::preinit (default seed 1337); worlds: emplaced by WorldTerrainSys::preinit with its `seed` param. EnTT's ctx().emplace keeps an existing value, so the first emplacer wins. Density at world height y: base_level + height_amplitude * fbm2D(x, z) - y + overhang_amplitude * fbm3D; > 0 is solid. Used by ChunkGeneratorSys jobs, TerrainColliders (creates its own when absent), PlayerControl, VRControl and base scene systems (surfaceHeight).

| `height_frequency` | `float` | 1/700 | per world unit (5 octaves FBm, gain 0.5, lacunarity 2) |
